title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Discover ten distinct study environments across the Centre College campus, from historic reading rooms to modern collaborative labs and outdoor classrooms.

cards.title: Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Crounse Hall
cards.notes: Reserve these rooms online via the library homepage for collaborative group work or focused team projects.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms located within the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Students may reserve study rooms and seminar rooms on the Library home page.
cards.access_notes: Open 100.5 hours weekly; Centre ID required for checkout and reservations.

cards.title: Learning Commons Tech Spaces
cards.subtitle: Main Floor, Crounse Hall
cards.notes: Find innovative and tech-savvy spaces for individual and group study adjacent to the Einstein Bros. Bagels shop.
cards.short_summary: A modern, collaborative hub on the library's main floor featuring tech-equipped study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The space includes innovative and tech-savvy spaces for individual and group study, seminar rooms, and an information kiosk.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; located on the main floor of Crounse Hall.

cards.title: Olin Hall STEM Collaboration Hub
cards.subtitle: Knowlton Center for Science and Mathematics
cards.notes: Utilize modern collaborative spaces designed for STEM students to work on complex data and science projects.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative study areas within the newly renovated science and mathematics center.
cards.evidence_claim: Classrooms, faculty offices, and student/faculty collaborative spaces are also located within Olin.
cards.access_notes: Primarily for STEM students but open for general academic use during building hours.

cards.title: Young Hall Late Night Labs
cards.subtitle: Rooms 134 and 213
cards.notes: Access dedicated computer labs for psychology and neuroscience research, open until midnight most nights.
cards.short_summary: Specialized computer labs in Young Hall available for late-night academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Young Hall Computer Labs: 134, 213. Monday-Thursday: open 4 pm to midnight.

cards.title: JVAC Creative Studios
cards.subtitle: West Walnut Street
cards.notes: Study in a unique environment surrounded by art; the building features purpose-built studios and a slide library.
cards.short_summary: Art-focused study and studio spaces in a renovated historic warehouse.
cards.evidence_claim: Classrooms, studios, a slide library, state-of-the-art hot glass studio, and faculty offices for the art department are located in JVAC.
cards.access_notes: Open to art students for studio work; general access during academic hours.

cards.title: Campus Center 24-Hour Lounges
cards.subtitle: Main Student Hub
cards.notes: Use your student ID for 24-hour card swipe access to common lounge areas for late-night study sessions.
cards.short_summary: Round-the-clock study lounges available to students in the main campus center.
cards.evidence_claim: The common areas of the building are accessible to students 24 hours a day by card swipe access.
cards.access_notes: 24-hour access for students via card swipe; public hours 8am-midnight.

cards.title: Historic Old Centre Classrooms
cards.subtitle: Main Administration Building
cards.notes: Study in one of the oldest college buildings in America; classrooms are available for student groups after hours.
cards.short_summary: Historic classroom and meeting spaces in the college's original 1820 building.
cards.evidence_claim: Classrooms in the academic buildings of the College are available to College groups, outside of class hours, for meetings and other purposes.
cards.access_notes: Available outside of scheduled class hours; online reservation required for groups.

cards.title: Grant Hall Music & Drama Studios
cards.subtitle: Norton Center for the Arts
cards.notes: Find quiet corners and academic studios in the academic wing of the Norton Center, home to music and drama programs.
cards.short_summary: Specialized academic and studio spaces for performing arts students.
cards.evidence_claim: Grant Hall, the academic wing of the Norton Center, is home to Centre College's music and drama programs. Complete with classrooms, studios and professional creative spaces.
cards.access_notes: Access for music and drama students; general academic use during building hours.

cards.title: Outdoor Academic Classrooms
cards.subtitle: Campus Grounds
cards.notes: Take your books outside to the Donald D. Buchanan or Elsie Wunsch outdoor classrooms for a fresh-air study session.
cards.short_summary: Designated outdoor spaces equipped for academic instruction and independent study.
cards.evidence_claim: Centre's campus features two outdoor classrooms where students enjoy an occasional outdoor classroom experience.
cards.access_notes: Open-air access; subject to weather and scheduled class use.

cards.title: Main Floor Quiet Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Crounse Hall
cards.notes: Seek out the quiet reading room on the main floor for a silent environment away from the Learning Commons' bustle.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated silent study area on the library's main floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Two quiet reading rooms on the main floor are often used for small, academic meetings as well as quiet study.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; designated for quiet study.
